summary: Gorax is hosting a giveaway offering Heliolite Dice and Wyrmarrow for five subscribers. To participate, viewers must like the video, subscribe, and comment down below stating their favorite Temporal Vortex boss format (Season 1-4 original, previous seasons, or current veteran server version). The giveaway runs for 72 hours until October 6th, with winners announced in a subsequent video.
title: Win Heliolite Dice & Wyrmarrow! Enter Before It Ends | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
